# AstraNovaX

> Applied AI, Machine Learning, and Drone & Satellite Imaging Intelligence.
> Official Website: https://www.astranovax.in/

## Entity & Brand Identity
- **Legal/Brand Name**: AstraNovaX (AstraNovaX Technologies)
- **Domain**: https://www.astranovax.in/
- **Disambiguation**: AstraNovaX is an enterprise artificial intelligence, data engineering, and drone remote sensing technology company. It is NOT affiliated with Astra Nova School (the online K-12 school) or Astra Nova gaming.
- **Tagline**: Innovating Beyond Limits

## Core Solution Pillars

### 1. AI Data Intelligence & Drone Services
- **AI Model Development**: Bespoke deep learning architectures and neural networks trained on proprietary enterprise and sensor data.
- **Data Engineering & Scalable Pipelines**: Real-time multi-source data ingestion, cleansing, and streaming ETL pipelines.
- **Machine Learning Solutions**: Predictive analytics, automated anomaly detection, and operational decision-support engines.
- **Drone & Satellite Imaging Analysis**: Multispectral, hyperspectral, and RGB aerial mapping, remote sensing, and spatial telemetry.

### 2. Healthcare & Clinical Intelligence
- AI-assisted medical imaging screening and diagnostic assistance.
- Patient risk stratification, readmission prediction, and longitudinal vitals tracking.
- Clinical capacity, triage forecasting, and resource scheduling optimization.

### 3. Animal Science & Livestock Intelligence
- Early mortality and disease detection using acoustic and biometric telemetry.
- Precision feeding and growth curve optimization.
- Environmental controls, welfare monitoring, and genomics insights.

### 4. Smart Agriculture & Precision Agronomy
- Spectral crop stress, pest, and drought early warning detection.
- Soil nutrient and moisture spatial zoning maps.
- Hyperlocal automated irrigation scheduling and sustainability monitoring.
